title: Western Blot Analysis Protocol
author: Kiichi Hirota
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x9mfr46
materials: Detect chemiluminescence using LAS-4000mini image analyzer.

steps.title: Harvest and Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells and prepare protein lysate using RIPA buffer.

substeps.instruction: Wash the cells with ice-cold PBS.
Add ice-cold RIPA buffer containing cOmplete™ Protease Inhibitor Cocktail.
Scrape cells and transfer the suspension to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate the lysate on ice for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate and Quantify Protein
steps.instruction: Separate the protein supernatant and determine its concentration.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant in a new microcentrifuge tube.
Determine protein concentration using DC ™ Protein Assay Kit.

steps.title: Run SDS-PAGE Gel
steps.instruction: Separate proteins by size using electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Load 35 µg of total protein on a SDS-PAGE gel.
Run the gel for 1 h at 100 V.

steps.title: Transfer Proteins to Membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins from the gel onto a PVDF membrane using the Trans-Blot Turbo™ Transfer System.

steps.title: Block the Membrane
steps.instruction: Place the blot in Blocking One and incubate with agitation for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the blot with appropriate dilutions of primary antibody at 4°C overnight.

steps.title: Wash Membrane After Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Place the blot in TBST and wash three times, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the blot with the species-matched horseradish peroxidase-conjugated secondary antibody for 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash Membrane After Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Place the blot in TBST and wash three times, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Detect Proteins
steps.instruction: Add Chemi-Lumi One Super to cover the blot and incubate for 1 minute.
